_comment: Parameter sensitivity of Section V (python -m risuav sensitivity): number of RIS elements N and backlog per GUE D_k. Fixed policy = seed-0 checkpoint trained at the reference values (no retraining); missions k = 0-19 of both test layouts (40 paired missions per platform). 'override' changes physics.REF before the service tables are rebuilt; 'env' changes a run-time setting without rebuilding. Reference values: N = 32x32, D_k = 40 Mbit (taken from the main evaluation on the same missions).

retrain._comment: Optional (--retrain), not reported in the paper: the policy is retrained (seed 0, full training settings) at two values and evaluated on the same missions.
